category: managed search store with built-in embedding and rerank, one-time free credit

free_tier.stated: Starter plan: $5 in one-time credits, no card required; 3 workspace users, 3 stores, 100 queries per minute and 6,000 upload requests per minute. Embeddings and reranking are billed inside Store indexing and search, not as standalone calls: standalone direct embedding and reranking APIs are no longer documented
free_tier.notes: the credit is USD and is spent on content tokens indexed, storage, and queries; semantic search is $4 per 1K queries and $7.50 per 1K with reranking

tooling: Python and TypeScript SDKs and a REST endpoint at api.mixedbread.com/v1/stores/search; upload files to a store, then search with search_options.rerank
chaining: a caller that needs raw vectors or a bare rerank call cannot get them here; Jina AI, Pinecone Inference and Cohere trial keys serve that shape

limits.value: $5 of one-time credit; at the listed prices $5 covers about 1,250 plain semantic queries or about 666 with reranking, before any indexing cost
Starter: 100 queries per minute and 6,000 ingestion requests per minute; operation-class limits 1,200 reads, 600 lists, 360 writes per minute

identity_cost.detail: the pricing page states 'No card required' for Starter; unverified: the sign-up form fields, because the app page answered with a login wall to the page reader

reliability_note: the earlier standalone embedding and reranking APIs were withdrawn from the documentation; the open-weight models remain on Hugging Face
confidence_note: the plan, credit, no-card statement, limits, prices and the withdrawal of the direct APIs are quoted from vendor pages; the sign-up form was not readable.

evidence.quote: Try Mixedbread with $5 in one-time credits. No card required.
evidence.proved: the Starter plan is free, with $5 of one-time credits and no card

evidence.proved: the $5 credit buys roughly 666 semantic queries with reranking, since each thousand cost $7.50

evidence.quote: pages are no longer part of the current documentation, but the model artifacts
